influences.name: Soft Cell
influences.context: Originally intended as a dance track inspired by Soft Cell's Torch, the song began to take shape when Marian Gold added lyrics over a demo played by Bernard Lloyd and Frank.

influences.name: David Bowie
influences.context: Gold standard was Bowie. But I never tried to imitate him or anyone else of my idols.

influences.name: OMD
influences.context: In that phase we were probably closest comparable to bands like OMD or Blancmange.
